name: browser-use-impl
description: The browser-use@1 SERVICE HOST (provider `registry`): it owns the provider registry, the selection policy (explicit provider, else configured default, else the single registered provider, else the typed no-provider error), the seam bounds (snapshot node cap, text cap, screenshot byte cap, call/navigation/action deadlines, session cap) and the typed delegation of a call to the selected provider. Providers are SEPARATE plugins that register themselves here; this plugin imports no provider and launches no browser, so the manifest declares execution none.

config.description: Which provider answers by default and the bounds of one call.

provider.description: Default provider id (e.g. playwright). Absent: take the single registered provider, or fail with browser-use.ambiguous.

maxSessions.description: Live sessions allowed at once across providers; one more is a typed browser-use.session-limit.

maxSnapshotNodes.description: Node cap of ONE snapshot answer (a truncated answer says so).

maxTextChars.description: Inline character cap of extract/evaluate answers (the hard ceiling of the seam is 200000).

maxImageBytes.description: Byte cap of ONE screenshot FILE: a bigger image is a typed browser-use.oversized naming the real size, never a silent drop.

navigationTimeoutMs.description: Default navigation budget when the caller names none.

actionTimeoutMs.description: Default per-action budget (click/type/wait) when the caller names none.

screenshotDir.description: FALLBACK directory for screenshot FILES. The provider's own `screenshotDir` (plugins.browser-use-playwright) WINS when it names one; the seam default is <tmpdir>/workbench-browser-use. The answer is always an ABSOLUTE path, never inline base64.

storageStateDir.description: Directory holding the per-session storage-state files (default: <tmpdir>/workbench-browser-use/state); the same convention web-session uses, so a session can be continued across the two.
